entities.summary: Andrei Andreyevich Fayt (Feit) (Russian: Андрей Андреевич Файт (Фейт); 29 August 1903 – 17 January 1976) was a Soviet film actor. He appeared in 44 films between 1925 and 1976. He was born in Nizhny Novgorod, Russia and died in Moscow.
